title: 第11章 换签第12章 死剑不认主
lines: ：药铺管事把药包递出来的时候，手指压得很重。
纸包在柜台上陷出一道浅痕。
“寒露丹没有，温脉散减半。沈照夜，问剑初试结束之前，药铺只认这份条子。初试一完，旧账照算。”
热气从纸缝里钻出来，带着一点苦味。
沈霜站在他身后，眼睛一直看着那包药。
像怕一伸手，药就又没了。
“写账的时候声音比钟还响，给药的时候跟割肉似的。”
周野刚要回嘴，沈照夜抬手拦住他。
三人出了药铺，细雨还没停。
沈霜把药包抱在怀里，走了几步，忽然低声说：
小丫头眼眶红着，却还是笑了一下。
裴岳那几剑没有伤到要害，却把旧伤都震开了。照夜断剑背在身后，安静得像睡着，可剑怨还在骨头里一点点磨。
他把药包往沈霜怀里推了推。
周野看着他们，声音忽然低了些。
“你赢了裴岳，裴家不会就这么算。”
沈照夜抬头，看向练剑场方向。
content_en:
: When the drug store manager handed out the medicine package, his fingers pressed heavily.
The paper package made a shallow mark on the counter.
"Basic medicine."
He made it very clear.
"There is no Cold Dew Pill, and the Wenmai Powder is reduced by half. Shen Zhaoye, before the first test of Wenjian is over, the drug store will only recognize this note. Once the first test is over, the old accounts will be settled."
Shen Zhaoye took the medicine bag.
The medicine paper is still hot.
The heat came out from the cracks in the paper, carrying a bit of bitterness.
Shen Shuang stood behind him, keeping his eyes on the packet of medicine.
She didn't reach out.
As if I was afraid that if I stretched out my hand, the medicine would be gone again.
Zhou Ye looked furious.
"When I was writing the accounts, the sound was louder than a bell, and when I was administering the medicine, it was like cutting flesh."
The drug store manager's face darkened.
"Zhou Ye, do you also want to stop taking medicine?"
Just as Zhou Ye was about to reply, Shen Zhaoye raised his hand to stop him.
"Let's go."
He can't make trouble in the drug store now.
Got the medicine.
Let Shen Shuang eat it first.
The three of them left the drug store, and the drizzle hadn't stopped yet.
Shen Shuang held the medicine bag in her arms, walked a few steps, and suddenly whispered:
"Brother."
Shen Zhaoye looked at her.
The little girl's eyes were red, but she still smiled.
"You won this packet of medicine today."
Shen Zhaoye said nothing.
His chest still hurts.
My right arm hurts too.
Pei Yue's swords didn't hurt any vital parts, but they opened all the old wounds. Zhaoye held the broken sword behind his back, as quiet as if he was sleeping, but the resentment of the sword was still grinding away in his bones.
He pushed the medicine bag into Shen Shuang's arms.
"Take the medicine first."
Shen Shuang nodded.
Zhou Ye looked at them and his voice suddenly became lower.
"If you win over Pei Yue, the Pei family won't just settle it like that."
"I know."
"Neither can Han Song."
Shen Zhaoye raised his head and looked in the direction of the sword practice field.
The bell is still ringing at the sword-asking platform.
The first round is not over.
title_en: Chapter 11 Changing Lots Chapter 12 Death Sword Refuses to Recognize its Master
